- Keep documentation specific to observable behaviors and dates (you've done this well in the performance_log).
- Add a short paragraph offering reasonable accommodations and remind the employee of available support (mentorship, pairing sessions, learning stipend).

I'm attaching an alternate HR wording snippet you can drop into the draft (see signature_matrix.xlsx for who signs what). Also, I recommend you schedule the initial meeting with calendar hold and include People Ops so we have a consistent record.
